operations.details: Verified 4 documentation files exist via GitHub API
Version bump 2.7.0 → 2.8.0, added verification metadata and skill gap analysis
changes: Added documentation_completed with verified URLs and SHAs
Added learnings section with 3 key findings

phi_cps_impact.alert_reason: Cumulative delta stable - reality sync is metadata correction only

components.note: Verification and metadata correction do not impact semantic complexity

verification_findings.assumption_corrected: Documentation was assumed absent but verified present
verification_findings.analysis_error: LLM made incorrect assumption without GitHub API check

findings.impact: Cannot verify files exist after push, leads to false positives/negatives
findings.remediation: Implement skill to fetch file list from commit SHA and compare with expected

findings.impact: Cannot push to protected branches (BRAIN, FLUENCE, ECOYSTEM)
findings.remediation: Implement skill to detect protection and create PR workflow automatically

findings.impact: ECOS_ROOT can drift from GitHub truth without auto-verification
findings.remediation: Upgrade existing skill to fetch real GitHub state on every update

findings.impact: Manual documentation generation, no validation pipeline
findings.remediation: Implement skill to generate markdown, validate format, and push with verification

recommendations: CRITICAL: Implement PostCommitVerifierSkill before any further GitHub operations
CRITICAL: Implement BranchProtectionHandlerSkill to handle protected repos
HIGH: Upgrade MetadataSyncSkill with auto-verification via GitHub API
HIGH: After P0 skills deployed, proceed with P1 documentation (4 guides)
MEDIUM: Create test suite for P0 skills (minimum 10 tests each)
MEDIUM: Integrate P0 skills into NoHitlMasterPipeline
MEDIUM: Document P0 skill architecture and usage patterns
LOW: Consider implementing DocumentationPublisherSkill for full automation

learnings.lesson: Always verify GitHub state via API before asserting file presence/absence
learnings.impact: Prevents false positives/negatives and wasted diagnostic effort
learnings.action: Make PostCommitVerifierSkill mandatory in all GitHub write operations

learnings.lesson: ECOS_ROOT metadata can be correct even when LLM analysis is wrong
learnings.impact: Trust metadata more, verify less - but still verify via API
learnings.action: Implement auto-verification on every ECOS_ROOT update

learnings.lesson: LLM orchestration without autonomous agent execution has critical gaps
learnings.impact: Cannot detect silent failures, drift, or handle edge cases
learnings.action: Delegate verification and correction to autonomous Skills, not LLM

deliverables: Test suite for P0 skills (20+ tests)
next_batch_preview.note: P0 skills are critical blockers - must complete before resuming P1 documentation
